_comment: Values declared in data that no code reads, accepted for now. The data->code check in validate_data.py fails on anything unread that is NOT listed here, so this file is the record of known gaps rather than a way to silence the check. Shrink it by wiring a consumer, never by adding a line without a reason.

base_bonuses stat._reason: Skill payouts with no consumer yet. `_pct` is a percentage, `party_` means one member's skill pays the whole party (best member — see PartyBonuses), a bare name is flat. Four remain, each blocked on design work rather than wiring: crafting_quality_pct and crafting_yield_pct wait on the equipment and crafting audit (non-consumable items gaining a quality, Smithing producing equipment); loot_quality_pct waits on the loot design (total value from the defeated party's XP, with Luck buying a chance at one better item instead of several common ones); trap_detection_pct waits on the traps design. All three are written up in TODO.

status effect._reason: Behaviour strings on statuses.json entries that no code interprets. Several are one-off mechanics on a single status; `knockback` gains a reader when forced movement lands.
